title: wiretap: Add support for writing LZ4
description:
Since LZ4 fast seek is now supported (for independent frames, the default with the lz4 command line), add support for writing LZ4 as well.

Ping #9311, #12385

@@ -379,6 +379,15 @@ The following features are either new or have been significantly updated since v
 
 * Global profiles can be used in tshark by using `--global-profile` option.
 
+* Fast random access is supported with LZ4 compressed files (when compressed
+  with independent blocks, which is the default). This provides much more
+  responsive GUI performance when jumping to different packets. gzip compressed
+  files also support fast random seeking (since 1.8.0), but Zstd compressed
+  do not.
+
+* Existing capture files can be saved with LZ4 compression. LZ4 has an emphasis
+  on speed and may be particularly useful for large files.

commits_data.title: Qt: Add GUI support for saving in LZ4 format
commits_data.message:
Qt: Add GUI support for saving in LZ4 format

Add GUI support for saving in LZ4 format as well as gzip and
uncompressed. Replace the current checkbox with a group box.
The group box looks better alongside the packet range group box
for Export Packet Dissections and would be appropriate to
substitute into the Capture Options dialog in a later commit;
a combobox might look more natural for the ordinary Save As window.

Change the work to fix up the file extension a bit, so that
it can switch between .gz and .lz4
